messages.subject: MDYL winter registration window: confirmation and reminders
messages.snippet: Dear club secretaries,  This is the league's confirmation of the arrangements for the 2026-27 winter registration wind...
messages.body:
Dear club secretaries,

This is the league's confirmation of the arrangements for the 2026-27 winter registration window, which closes at 12:00 on Thursday 26 November 2026. Please read it to the end; several points have changed since the summer.

1. Submissions. Clubs record each player's status in their own registration base, which the league portal reads at the close. Only players marked Registered are carried onto the league's team sheets.

2. Duplicate check. The league portal checks every club's submissions against each other throughout the window and keeps the result for each player in its dual registrations table. A player registered with another club in the league cannot be registered by you unless the row shows Released - transfer cleared. The league applies the table as it stands when the window closes.

3. Age groups. Age groups run from 1 September to 31 August, as in the rulebook. A player may play up one age group with written parental consent; nobody may play down.

4. Coaches. Each team needs two named coaches with a current enhanced DBS and an in-date safeguarding course at the close. Clubs check this themselves under their own safeguarding policy; the league audits a sample in January.

5. Fees. League affiliation fees for the season were invoiced to clubs in September and are not affected by the window.

6. Referees. The referees' appointments secretary asks that any fixture moves for December are notified by 5 December.

7. AGM resolutions. The resolutions carried at the AGM on 14 November are attached to this message (and your secretary's copy is filed with the league papers). Where a resolution amends a rule, the amended rule applies to this window.

8. Kit. Shirt numbers do not need to be submitted this season.

With thanks for your work,

Keith Dunstable
Registrations officer, Merrowdale & District Youth League
